mapper.insert: insert into profile values( #{mem_id}, null, null, null, 0, 0, null, #{mem_bir} )
mapper.select: SELECT P.MEM_ID, M.MEM_NICKNAME, M.MEM_BIR, P.PROFILE_PHOTO, P.PROFILE_HEADERPHOTO, P.PROFILE_INTRO, P.PROFILE_URL, P.PROFILE_POSTCNT, P.PROFILE_FRIENDCNT FROM PROFILE P JOIN MEMBER M ON P.MEM_ID = M.MEM_ID WHERE P.MEM_ID = #{memId}
SELECT POST_INDEX, MEM_ID, POST_CON, POST_PHOTO, POST_DATE FROM POST WHERE MEM_ID = #{memId} ORDER BY POST_DATE DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE PROFILE SET PROFILE_INTRO = #{profile_intro}, PROFILE_URL = #{profile_url}, PROFILE_PHOTO = #{profile_photo}, PROFILE_HEADERPHOTO = #{profile_headerphoto} WHERE MEM_ID = #{mem_id}
